question: Among users who have received both 'Teacher' and 'Supporter' badges and are located in 'New York', find the display name of the one with the highest reputation. Additionally, determine whether their most recently edited post is well-finished (i.e., has a non-null ClosedDate).

arguments.sql:
WITH QualifiedUsers AS (
    SELECT u.XCL_052 AS UserId, u.XCL_055 AS DisplayName, u.XCL_053 AS Reputation
    FROM users u
    WHERE u.XCL_058 = 'New York'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM badges b1
          WHERE b1.XCL_002 = u.XCL_052 AND b1.XCL_003 = 'Teacher'
      )
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM badges b2
          WHERE b2.XCL_002 = u.XCL_052 AND b2.XCL_003 = 'Supporter'
      )
),
TopUser AS (
    SELECT UserId, DisplayName
    FROM QualifiedUsers
    ORDER BY Reputation DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
MostRecentPost AS (
    SELECT p.XCL_044 AS ClosedDate
    FROM posts p
    WHERE p.XCL_033 = (SELECT UserId FROM TopUser)
      AND p.XCL_041 IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY p.XCL_041 DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT tu.DisplayName,
       CASE WHEN mrp.ClosedDate IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsWellFinished
FROM TopUser tu
CROSS JOIN MostRecentPost mrp

WITH QualifiedUsers AS (
    SELECT u.XCL_052 AS UserId, u.XCL_055 AS DisplayName, u.XCL_053 AS Reputation
    FROM users u
    WHERE u.XCL_058 = 'New York'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM badges b1
          WHERE b1.XCL_002 = u.XCL_052 AND b1.XCL_003 = 'Teacher'
      )
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM badges b2
          WHERE b2.XCL_002 = u.XCL_052 AND b2.XCL_003 = 'Supporter'
      )
),
TopUser AS (
    SELECT UserId, DisplayName
    FROM QualifiedUsers
    ORDER BY Reputation DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
MostRecentPost AS (
    SELECT p.XCL_044 AS ClosedDate
    FROM posts p
    WHERE p.XCL_033 = (SELECT UserId FROM TopUser)
      AND p.XCL_041 IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY p.XCL_041 DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT tu.DisplayName,
       CASE WHEN mrp.ClosedDate IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsWellFinished
FROM TopUser tu
CROSS JOIN MostRecentPost mrp
